journal_name: Journal of the European Economic Association

articles.title_en: Unintended Consequences of the Global Derivatives Market Reform
articles.title_cn: 全球衍生品市场改革的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: Following the early implementation of the global over-the-counter (OTC) derivatives market reform in the USA and the associated increase in trading costs, US banks shifted up to 60% of their OTC derivatives activity abroad, particularly toward less regulated jurisdictions. Consistent with a cost saving incentive of regulatory arbitrage, we find that this flight abroad is driven by costlier blocks of the reform and subsequently causes a narrowing of swap spreads. We further show that this regulatory arbitrage causes an increase in financial risk as more activity is shifted to more lenient jurisdictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国率先实施全球场外（OTC）衍生品市场改革以及相关交易成本上升之后，美国银行将其场外衍生品活动的多达60%转移至海外，尤其是转向监管较宽松的司法管辖区。与监管套利的成本节约动机一致，我们发现这种海外转移是由改革中成本较高的部分所驱动，并随后导致互换利差收窄。我们进一步表明，随着更多活动转移到更宽松的司法管辖区，这种监管套利导致金融风险增加。

articles.title_en: The Effectiveness of Environmental Provisions in Regional Trade Agreements
articles.title_cn: 区域贸易协定中环境条款的有效性
articles.abstract_en: Trade liberalization can spur environmental degradation. Concerns over these adverse impacts have led to a debate over the need for environmental provisions in regional trade agreements (RTAs); however, the effectiveness of such provisions is unknown. In this paper, we provide new plausibly causal evidence that environmental provisions are effective in limiting deforestation following the entry into force of RTAs. We exploit high resolution, satellite-derived estimates of deforestation, and identify the content of RTAs using a new dataset with detailed information on individual provisions. Accounting for the potential endogeneity of environmental provisions in RTAs, we find that the inclusion of specific provisions aimed at protecting forests and/or biodiversity almost entirely offsets the net increases in forest loss observed in similar RTAs without such provisions. The effects are particularly strong in tropical, developing countries with greater biodiversity. The inclusion of these provisions limits agricultural expansion and agricultural trade.
articles.abstract_cn: 贸易自由化可能加剧环境退化。对这些不利影响的担忧引发了关于区域贸易协定（RTAs）中是否需要环境条款的辩论；然而，此类条款的有效性尚不明确。在本文中，我们提供了新的看似因果的证据，表明环境条款在RTAs生效后能有效限制森林砍伐。我们利用高分辨率、卫星衍生的森林砍伐估计，并使用一个包含个别条款详细信息的新数据集来识别RTAs的内容。考虑到RTAs中环境条款的潜在内生性，我们发现，包含旨在保护森林和/或生物多样性的具体条款几乎完全抵消了在没有此类条款的类似RTAs中观察到的森林损失的净增加。这些效应在生物多样性更丰富的热带发展中国家尤为显著。这些条款的纳入限制了农业扩张和农产品贸易。

articles.abstract_en: Educational institutions not only build human capital; they also shape culture. We present a model of cultural dynamics produced by cultural transmission through the education system. Groups that are culturally marginalized become economically disadvantaged and exhibit various forms of resistance to education. First, individuals may drop out of education to avoid its cultural content. Second, individuals may invest in other forms of socialization to tune out the cultural content of education. Finally, cultural communities may collectively resist mainstream education by turning out to change curricula or establish their own schools. We show that resistance to education can make it impossible for a policymaker to eliminate alternative cultural traits from the population. In fact, a policymaker may have to moderate the cultural content of education or else face a backlash which increases the spread of alternative cultural traits. Our analysis unifies a growing body of empirical work on the effects of cultural policies and makes new predictions regarding the effect of socializing institutions on cultural dynamics.
articles.abstract_cn: 教育机构不仅构建人力资本，还塑造文化。我们提出了一个通过教育系统进行文化传播所产生的文化动态模型。文化上被边缘化的群体在经济上处于不利地位，并表现出各种形式的对教育的抵制。首先，个体可能辍学以避免其文化内容。其次，个体可能投资于其他形式的社会化以屏蔽教育的文化内容。最后，文化社区可能通过参与改变课程或建立自己的学校来集体抵制主流教育。我们表明，对教育的抵制可能使政策制定者无法从人口中消除替代性文化特征。事实上，政策制定者可能不得不缓和教育的文化内容，否则将面临反弹，这反而会增加替代性文化特征的传播。我们的分析统一了关于文化政策效果的日益增长的实证研究，并对社会化机构对文化动态的影响做出了新的预测。

articles.title_en: Voting Rights, Agenda Control and Information Aggregation
articles.title_cn: 投票权、议程控制与信息聚合
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the comparative properties of voting rules based on the richness of their ballot spaces, assuming a given distribution of voting rights. We focus on how well voting rules aggregate the information dispersed among voters. We consider how different voting rules affect both voters’ decisions at the voting stage and the incentives of the agenda-setter, who decides whether to put the proposal to a vote. Without agenda-setter, the voting efficiency of rules is higher when their ballot space is richer. Moreover, full-information efficiency requires full divisibility of the votes. In the presence of an agenda-setter, we uncover a novel trade-off: in some cases, rules with high voting efficiency provide worse incentives to the agenda-setter to select good proposals. This negative effect can be large enough to wash out the higher voting efficiency of even the most efficient rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了基于选票空间丰富程度的投票规则的比较性质，假设投票权分布给定。我们关注投票规则如何有效地聚合分散在选民中的信息。我们考虑不同的投票规则如何影响投票阶段选民的决定，以及议程设定者（决定是否将提案付诸表决）的激励。在没有议程设定者的情况下，选票空间越丰富，规则的投票效率越高。此外，完全信息效率要求投票完全可分。在存在议程设定者的情况下，我们发现了一个新的权衡：在某些情况下，投票效率高的规则为议程设定者选择好的提案提供的激励较差。这种负面效应可能大到足以抵消即使是最有效规则的更高投票效率。

articles.title_en: Decentralized Targeting of Agricultural Credit Programs: Private Versus Political Intermediaries
articles.title_cn: 农业信贷项目的分散化目标定位：私人中介与政治中介的比较
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a field experiment in India comparing two ways of delegating selection of microcredit clients among smallholder farmers to local intermediaries: a private trader (TRAIL), versus a local–government appointee (GRAIL). Selected beneficiaries in both schemes were equally likely to take up and repay loans, and experienced similar increases in borrowing and farm output. However farm profits increased and unit costs of production decreased significantly only in TRAIL. While there is some evidence of superior selection by ability and landholding in TRAIL, the results are mainly driven by greater reduction of unit production costs for TRAIL treated farmers than GRAIL treated farmers of similar ability or landholding. We develop and test a model where the TRAIL agents’ role as middlemen in the agricultural supply chain enabled and motivated them to offer treated farmers business advice, which helped them lower unit costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在印度进行了一项实地实验，比较了将小农户中的微型信贷客户选择权委托给当地中介的两种方式：私人贸易商（TRAIL）与地方政府任命者（GRAIL）。两种方案中被选中的受益者在贷款获取和偿还方面可能性相同，并且在借款和农业产出方面经历了相似的增加。然而，仅在TRAIL中，农场利润显著增加，单位生产成本显著降低。虽然有证据表明TRAIL在能力和土地持有方面的选择更优，但结果主要归因于TRAIL处理的农民在相似能力或土地持有下，单位生产成本的降低幅度大于GRAIL处理的农民。我们开发并测试了一个模型，其中TRAIL代理作为农业供应链中的中间人角色，使他们能够并有动力向处理过的农民提供商业建议，这有助于降低单位成本。

articles.title_en: Examining Income Expectations in the College and Early Post-College Periods: New Distributional Tests of Rational Expectations
articles.title_cn: 大学及毕业后初期收入预期的检验：理性预期的新分布检验
articles.abstract_en: Using unique longitudinal probabilistic expectations data from the Berea Panel Study, which cover both college and early post-college periods, we examine young adults’ beliefs about their future incomes. We introduce two new approaches to testing whether, ex ante, agents exhibit Rational Expectations. We show that taking into account the additional information about higher moments of individual belief distributions contained in probabilistic expectations data reveals violations of Rational Expectations that are not detected by existing mean-based tests. Empirically, we find that our subjects underestimate the level of uncertainty they face about future incomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用伯里亚小组研究中独特的纵向概率预期数据，该数据覆盖大学及毕业后初期，我们考察了年轻人对其未来收入的信念。我们引入了两种新方法来检验事前个体是否表现出理性预期。我们表明，考虑概率预期数据中包含的个体信念分布高阶矩的额外信息，揭示了现有基于均值的检验未能检测到的理性预期违背。实证上，我们发现受试者低估了他们面临的未来收入不确定性水平。

articles.title_en: Firms’ Inflation Expectations: New Evidence from France
articles.title_cn: 企业通胀预期：来自法国的新证据
articles.abstract_en: Using a new survey of firms’ inflation expectations in France, we provide novel evidence about the measurement and formation of inflation expectations on the part of firms. First, French firms report inflation expectations with a smaller, but still positive, bias than households and display less disagreement. Second, we characterize the extent and manner in which the wording of questions matters for the measurement of firms’ inflation expectations. Third, we document whether and how the position of the respondent within the firm affects the provided responses. Fourth, because our survey measures firms’ expectations about aggregate and firm-level wage growth along with their inflation expectations, we can show that expectations about wages are even more condensed than firms’ inflation expectations and almost completely uncorrelated with them, indicating that firms perceive little link between price and wage inflation. Finally, an experimental treatment indicates that an exogenous change in firms’ inflation expectations has no effect on their aggregate wage expectations.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用一项关于法国企业通胀预期的新调查，我们提供了关于企业通胀预期测量和形成的新证据。首先，法国家庭报告的通胀预期偏差较小但仍为正，且分歧较少。其次，我们描述了问题的措辞对企业通胀预期测量的影响程度和方式。第三，我们记录了受访者在企业内的职位是否以及如何影响所提供的回答。第四，由于我们的调查同时测量了企业对总体和公司层面工资增长的预期以及其通胀预期，我们可以表明，工资预期比企业通胀预期更为集中，且几乎完全不相关，这表明企业认为价格通胀与工资通胀之间几乎没有联系。最后，一项实验性处理表明，企业通胀预期的外生变化对其总体工资预期没有影响。

articles.title_cn: 作为动态竞争的选举活动
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model of electoral campaigns in which two office-motivated candidates allocate their budgets over time to affect their odds of winning. We measure the candidates’ evolving odds of winning using a state variable that tends to decay over time, and we refer to it as the candidates’ “relative popularity.” In our baseline model, the equilibrium ratio of spending by each candidate equals the ratio of their initial budgets; spending is independent of past realizations of relative popularity; and there is a positive relationship between the strength of decay in the popularity process and the rate at which candidates increase their spending over time as election day approaches. We use this relationship to recover estimates of the perceived decay rate in popularity leads in U.S. subnational elections.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个选举活动模型，其中两位以职位为导向的候选人随时间分配预算以影响其获胜几率。我们使用一个随时间趋于衰减的状态变量来衡量候选人不断变化的获胜几率，并将其称为候选人的“相对人气”。在我们的基线模型中，每位候选人支出的均衡比率等于其初始预算的比率；支出与相对人气的过去实现值无关；并且人气过程的衰减强度与候选人随着选举日临近而增加支出的速率之间存在正相关关系。我们利用这一关系来估计美国地方选举中人气领先感知衰减率的估计值。

articles.title_en: Immigration and Business Dynamics: Evidence from U.S. Firms
articles.title_cn: 移民与企业动态：来自美国企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of immigration on U.S. local business dynamics using a comprehensive collection of survey and administrative data. It finds heterogeneous impacts across the employer productivity distribution that favor higher-productivity firms and lead to increases in average local earnings. Responses to immigration along the exit margin are particularly important. Immigrant inflows cull establishments from low-productivity firms while preserving establishments from high-productivity firms. Overall, reduced exit accounts for 43% of immigrant-induced job creation and 41% of immigrant-induced earnings growth. A general equilibrium model proposes a mechanism that ties immigrant workers to high-productivity employers and shows how accounting for changes to the employer productivity distribution can yield substantially larger estimates of immigrant-generated economic surplus than canonical models of labor demand.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用调查和行政数据的综合集合，研究了移民对美国地方企业动态的影响。研究发现，移民对雇主生产率分布的影响具有异质性，有利于高生产率企业，并导致当地平均收入增加。移民在退出边际上的反应尤为重要。移民流入淘汰了低生产率企业的机构，同时保留了高生产率企业的机构。总体而言，退出减少占移民引起的就业创造的43%，占移民引起的收入增长的41%。一个一般均衡模型提出了一种机制，将移民工人与高生产率雇主联系起来，并表明考虑雇主生产率分布的变化可以得出比经典劳动力需求模型大得多的移民产生的经济剩余估计。

articles.title_en: Political Power, Elite Control, and Long-Run Development: Evidence from Brazil
articles.title_cn: 政治权力、精英控制与长期发展：来自巴西的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes how changes in the concentration of political power affect long-run development. We study Brazil’s military dictatorship whose rise to power dramatically altered the distribution of power of local political elites. We document that municipalities that were more politically concentrated prior to the dictatorship in the 1960s are relatively richer in 2000, despite being poorer initially. Our evidence suggests that this reversal of fortune was the result of the military’s policies aimed at undermining the power of traditional elites. These policies increased political competition among traditional elites, leading to better governance, more public goods, and higher income levels.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了政治权力集中度的变化如何影响长期发展。我们研究了巴西的军事独裁，其上台 dramatically 改变了地方政治精英的权力分配。我们记录了在1960年代独裁之前政治集中度较高的市镇，在2000年相对更富裕，尽管最初较为贫穷。我们的证据表明，这种命运逆转是军方旨在削弱传统精英权力的政策的结果。这些政策增加了传统精英之间的政治竞争，带来了更好的治理、更多的公共物品和更高的收入水平。
